title: Scheme for Economic Empowerment of DNTs (SEED) — Development and Welfare Board for De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Communities (DWBDNC)
sourceDescription: DWBDNC's own content page (dwbdnc.dosje.gov.in/content/seed-scheme) and its linked official SEED Scheme Guidelines PDF. The PDF's binary content could not be parsed to text by automated fetch during this ingestion; the income-ceiling and component figures below were corroborated via web search of secondary summaries of the same official guidelines. Re-verify against the guidelines PDF directly (e.g. with a PDF-text-extraction tool) before treating this as final.

sections.text: Members of De-notified (DNT), Nomadic (NT), and Semi-Nomadic (SNT) communities. Beneficiaries under the scheme are identified by the State Government/UTs, which issue the necessary certificate for availing benefits.

For the free-coaching component, only students from DNT/NT/SNT communities with an annual family income of Rs. 8 lakh or less are eligible, provided they are not availing a similar benefit from another Central or State government scheme.
All DNT/NT/SNT persons staying in villages and rural areas in India are eligible for the SEED Livelihoods component, which supports income-generation at the community level.

Besides free coaching for competitive examinations (Civil Services, SSC, NEET, IIT-JEE, banking exams) and the livelihood component, SEED also assists with health insurance coverage (linked to Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana) and financial assistance for house construction.
